'''Mark Watts Trooper Assault''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mark Watts]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15741">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15741 Trooper Assault], DeckTech (Mark "Sith Master" Watts, 3 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15741/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15741/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Trooper Assault'''
* '''Author:''' Mark "Sith Master" Watts
* '''Published:''' May 3, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 1.5
* '''Description:''' A trooper deck that uses trooper assault to beat opponent.  Just hope they don't play grimtash.

=== Strategy ===

Deploy lots of troopers, battle, play trooper assault, you win the game.
